Bishweshwer Prasad Singh @ Bishweshar Prasad Singh son of Late Indradeo Singh, Permanent R/o Vill.- Hasanpura, P.O.- Babu Tola Kohara, P.S.- Maker, District- Saran, State- Bihar and at present owner, proprietor and Manager of Pankaj Transport Company (Rail, Road & Air Carriers, Transporters & Clearing Agents), Nehru Road, Moti Mill Compound, Khalpara, Silliguri, P.S.- Silliguri, District- Darjeeling, State- West Bengal and its Branch Office at Pankaj Transport Company, Sonouli chowk, Hansada Road, Gulab Bigha, Nirmal Daga Compound, P.S.- Sadar, District- Purnea, State- Bihar .... .... P Versus 1. The State of Bihar .... .... Opposite Party/s = Appearance : For the Petitioner/s : Mr. Shyam Kishore Sinha For the Opposite Party/s : Mr. Gopesh Kumar(App) ================================== = = = = = = = = CORAM: HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE DINESH KUMAR SINGH ORAL ORDER 2 20-08-2015 Heard learned counsels for the petitioner and the State.
texts.facts: The petitioner is apprehending arrest in a case registered for the offences punishable under Sections 419,420 and 307/34 of the Indian Penal Code and section 26 of Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006. The prosecution case is that one truck was intercepted loaded with Dalda and Refined oil which were being transported from Siliguri to Purnea without any valid document.
texts.arguments: It is submitted by the learned counsel for the petitioner that the entire prosecution case is misconceived as it is not initiated in accordance with the provision of Food Safety and Standards Bishweshwer Prasad Singh @ Bishweshar ... vs The State Of Bihar on 20 August, 2015 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/42068747/ 1 Act, 2006. It is further submitted that the goods in question were transported from Siliguri and thereafter it was seized at Purnea but no copy of the seizurelist was ever supplied to the co accused Bimal Saha who was getting the seized articles transported. It is also submitted that petitioner is simply the owner/proprietor of Pankaj Transport Company on whose truck the goods were being transported when the owner of the goods has been granted anticipatory bail vide Cr. Misc. No. 31673 of 2015. Statement has been made in paragraph 3 of the petition that the petitioner has no criminal antecedent.
